item: M13 + M65 — the review periods: one shared calendar ruler, the weekly and quarterly buckets, and the record of which periods were saved
issue: M13: Ep 26 asks for a weekly and a quarterly review and the payload had only daily/monthly buckets (`performance.js` carried no weekly or quarterly series at all), so the review could never say what the weeks and quarters looked like. M65: the quarter already existed as a goal cadence (`period=month|quarter|year`), as a quarter-start computation in `routes/api.js` and as a saved review template since M99/M101 — what was missing was the quarterly SERIES beside the new weekly one and any record of which periods were actually reviewed. The two findings are therefore built as ONE delivery: one calendar ruler, two series, and the per-period record. The ledger reads M13 and M65 as two items; both flip on this commit.

owned_surfaces.ruler: extracted/tradejournal/src/periods.js (periods-v1): the app's ONE calendar-period ruler — UTC days, Monday-start weeks, calendar months/quarters/years, half-open [start,end) with last_day. Pure: no database, no environment, no filesystem and no clock of its own. The review artifacts (period-reviews.js), the M104 rule-change advisory (rule-changes.js) and the new series all read it, and the advisory/ruler agreement is asserted day by day across 2025-2027
owned_surfaces.series: src/performance.js: periodSeries(closed,kind) plus weeklySeries/quarterlySeries bucketed on the REVIEW calendar (UTC close-day, Monday-start week, calendar quarter), riding the existing payload beside the journal-timezone daily/monthly. Each bucket carries {kind, start, end, last_day, trades, wins, losses, breakeven, pnl, r, win_rate, unknown_net, unknown_r, days, basis}; a close with no clock at all is counted on `undated_closes` rather than guessed into a week
owned_surfaces.record: src/period-reviews.js (review-coverage-v1): coverageOf()/coverage()/coverageOptional() — a read-only record joining each canonical period to the artifact saved for that exact period on the trader's own account, states completed/draft/imported_unverified/unavailable/not_recorded, joined to that period's own recorded closes by bucket START (a quarter's key is `YYYY-Qn`, not a date)
owned_surfaces.endpoint: analytics.weekly, analytics.quarterly, analytics.undated_closes and analytics.review_periods on the EXISTING GET /api/analytics — no new route, scoped to the resolved analysed account with the payload's own window
owned_surfaces.card: public/js/views/review-periods.js (Views.reviewPeriods.card) mounted in public/js/views/analytics.js above its existing tabs and loaded by public/index.html

framing_rules: ONE ruler, not three: the review boundaries live in src/periods.js once, and the rule-change advisory reads the same ruler instead of its own second copy — the shape of the M59 defect (two grade ladders, one score graded differently by each)

two rulers, both labelled: daily/monthly keep the journal timezone and weekly/quarterly bucket on the review calendar; a close at 2026-10-04T23:30:00Z is week 2026-09-28 on the review calendar and Lagos day 2026-10-05 on the journal clock, and nothing moves a trade between them to make two numbers agree
a missing amount is not a zero: a bucket or period with no recorded net report `pnl: null` and count the close in `unknown_net`/`unknown_r`; a period with no closed trade reports `null`, never 0

a period that was not reviewed is not `missed`: `not_recorded` means only that no artifact was saved for that period, and the meaning sentence travels with the payload and is rendered on screen — a review done on paper or elsewhere leaves nothing here

an unknown record is not a clean record: an unreadable record is `state:'unavailable'` with `not_recorded:null`, never a period list full of 'no review', and a foreign or unowned account resolves to the same shape from the route's own scope

a draft is a draft and an imported copy is unverified: `draft`/`imported_unverified` are never counted as the trader's own completed review, and legacy/imported artifacts stay separate from own human reviews
a period still running is `open`, not unreviewed; an artifact whose stored period start is not a canonical period start is counted as outside the window rather than disappearing

the artifact is read, never written: `review_periods` adds no endpoint, writes nothing, and changes no grade, cap, permission, guardrail decision or plan-change permission — writing a review is still the trader's act

no reviewed-vs-unreviewed comparison: `outcome_compared:false` carries the sentence saying why — the amounts sit beside the state because both are facts about the same period, and comparing them would be a causal claim this journal has not measured
no 70 %/causal/predictive/broker/human/mental-state/provider/production claim; nothing retuned; no existing guard weakened; missing amount ≠ zero and unknown ≠ clean throughout

carried_not_owned.why: This milestone adds nothing carried: the parent (the actual 9c88e0a M12 release) already ships `tools/jsmin/**` and `src/rule-breaks.js`, so the delivered files the parent does not have are exactly this milestone's own two new files (`src/periods.js`, `public/js/views/review-periods.js`) — asserted in analysis/capture-m13-stages.py rather than assumed.
